$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md §3 — B1-B3: doors as route obstacles and as things a behaviour operates. Judge (1)-(3) as positions: the Visitor stands at the back door, ends in the west room and never crosses the locked front doorway; the Locksmith walks in through the front doorway it opened. ⚠ The door states themselves (Locked/Closed/Open) are on door entities that carry no unit name, so 'unlocks and opens' is judged only by what it lets the men do.

expect.name: the Visitor stands at the back door (within 3 m of its doorway)
the Visitor arrives in the west room
expect.after: the Visitor stands at the back door (within 3 m of its doorway)

expect.name: the Visitor never walks through the locked front doorway
the Locksmith walks through the front doorway
the Locksmith ends inside, at (102,103)
